title: Going Round in Circles
summary: Selwyn is shot at an event celebrating his 50 years of police service.
method: There was a man who approached Selwyn with a gun but never intended to shoot. The killer fired the gun using the man's hands. A cufflink from the killer dropped into the man's pants cuffs, linking him to the murder.
motive: Selwyn was about to figure out that the killer murdered a mutual friend of theirs. He was trying to ask for his contact info.
killer: The yacht club manager, Marlon Collins
notes: Marlon Collins was arrested in the first episode of the series. Camille makes an appearance on video call
